entry.title: Save $770 -- Hawaii getaway for 2
entry.summary:
This Sheraton resort is situated on the scenic east coast of Kauai, known as Hawaii's Garden Isle. It's a 10–20 minute drive from stunning Wailua Falls and the Fern Grotto lava rock cave. Guests can take a coastal bike ride to the shops and food trucks in nearby Kapaa. At the resort, enjoy five bars and restaurants, including a breakfast spot.

With this offer, stay 3 nights (or longer) in upgraded digs with ocean views, nab a $50 credit for food and drinks, skip the nightly resort fee (usually $45 per night) and save on luau tickets. It's rare to find a deal like this in Kauai, but Travelzoo members save up to $770.

entry.title: $229 -- Sleep up to 6 in this Lake Arrowhead chalet

Visit this fall and hike among the brilliant changing leaves. Or plan an early winter getaway. Either way, you'll score reduced rates on a private chalet. Add daily breakfast for two and a waived resort fee, and you'll save 55%–61%. Tip: The chalets sleep up to six guests, so bring the family.

entry.title: $799 -- Grand Cayman suite escape for 2, over 60% off
entry.summary:
This offer makes it easier to plan a Grand Cayman getaway without paying the usual peak-season rates. Travelzoo members save 40%–62% on stays into March. From $799, two guests can spend 3 nights (or more) with a welcome amenity, waived nightly amenity fees and upgraded accommodations.

Opened in May, this luxury property brings a polished, residential feel to George Town. Every suite covers more than 600 square feet, with a kitchenette and separate living area. The hotel is also home to the island’s only rooftop infinity pool. Beach days are covered: a complimentary shuttle reaches famous Seven Mile Beach in about 10 minutes.
